title: Classic Peruvian Papas a la Huancaina
description: A Peruvian dish made with boiled potatoes, spicy cheese sauce, and crispy bacon.
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and let them cool.
In a separate pan, cook the bacon until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled potatoes, cooked bacon, and thinly sliced onions.
Pour the huancaina sauce over the top and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
